summary: A hiring manager on the phone asks if it's a good time, then says right away that they are calling with an offer.
realLife: Employer guidance on offer calls says to introduce yourself, ask if it is a good time, state the offer purpose immediately, then cover title, pay, schedule, a response deadline, and time for questions.
sources: Indeed Hiring Resources, how to offer someone a job: https://www.indeed.com/hire/c/info/how-to-offer-someone-job
inGame: the job record (position, employer) carries what is offered; the call event can be a phone talk; needs: an offer or application record

turns.summary: The manager chats at length and reveals the offer only at the end.
turns.writesBack: the applicant feels strung along; a mood note

turns.summary: The manager sends the offer by email and skips the call.
turns.writesBack: no warmth; the applicant answers later and shorter

turns.summary: The manager names a date and time for an answer and keeps to it.
turns.writesBack: a deadline in the journal; pressure on the applicant
